component.name: T3-R Pantheon
component.summary: A compact Dock panel and full native chat for T3 Code

description.p: A native elementary OS client of the T3 Code server. The Dock opens a compact status panel for the currently paired server, with quick access to active work, usage, new chats and Settings. Open the full desktop window for the complete chat experience across every provider connected to that server.

Connect additional provider instances from Settings. Choose a provider, model and permission mode, and watch turns stream in: assistant text, commands, diffs and permission prompts you answer inline. Usage, Repos, Issues, diagnostics and local Claude Code transcripts are available in the full app.
T3 Code client with a Dock quick panel, full chat window, pairing, providers, usage, repos and diagnostics; offline Claude Code transcripts.
